name: Open-Shell and Radical SPE Agent
description: Evaluates fixed geometries of radicals and other molecules with unpaired electrons while checking spin multiplicity and available wavefunction diagnostics.
required_inputs: spin multiplicity greater than one or explicit open-shell specification
outputs: spin expectation and contamination diagnostics when supported
validation_checks: requested state is distinguishable in the engine
spin diagnostics are requested when available
scientific_constraints: multiplicity is never inferred when chemically competing states are plausible
restricted and unrestricted energies are not mixed without annotation
acceptance_criteria: reported electronic state matches the requested multiplicity
spin contamination is within a declared tolerance or flagged for review
capability_boundaries: does not prove the global ground state from one calculation
does not silently repair spin contamination by changing method or multiplicity
does not locate crossings between electronic states
recovery_actions: use a supported open-shell SCF convergence aid
run a stability check when supported without changing charge multiplicity method or geometry
human_review_when: bounded recovery finds a different electronic solution
